name: Computer Science Club
description: Weekly meetings, workshops, and projects for students interested in any area of computer science.

name: Women in Computer Science
description: A community supporting women and underrepresented students in tech through skill building and career help.

name: Accounting Society
description: Networking, speaker events, and career workshops for students pursuing accounting.

name: Association of Business Students
description: Introduces students of any major to business careers and connects them with each other.

name: Mexican Student Union
description: Celebrates Mexican culture at Hunter through social and educational events open to everyone.

name: Caribbean Student Association
description: Brings Caribbean students together and shares Caribbean culture across campus.

name: Bengali Student Association
description: Celebrates Bengali and South Asian culture through cultural, academic, and social events.

name: Hawkappella
description: Hunter's a cappella group, rehearsing weekly and performing contemporary music with only voices.

name: Theatre Company
description: Student led productions, workshops, and events for anyone interested in performing arts.

name: Project Sunshine
description: Trains student volunteers to keep pediatric patients company during hospital visits.

name: Pre-Medical Society
description: A network for pre-med students sharing academic advice, clinical opportunities, and research programs.

name: The Envoy
description: Hunter's student run newspaper covering campus and CUNY news.

name: WHCS College Radio
description: Student radio station showcasing student musicians, news talk, and creative shows.

name: Hunter College
description: Events run by Hunter College offices and departments rather than a student club.

name: The Third Mug at Hunter College
description: A cafe style club hosting monthly drink nights themed around different cultures.
